summary.note: Counts are COMPUTED from the entries above, not typed in -- mas_capability_check.m fails if they drift. Keys carry no spaces because jsonencode strips them. R1/R2/R3 benchmark ran for real on 2026-10-20 (docs/PHASE4_3_VERIFICATION_ZH.md); the official MATLAB MCP server is reachable over stdio. PARTIAL on the benchmark entry is deliberate: the task scripts are fixed, so it does not yet measure an agent's own skill selection or recovery. Phase 4.5 changed no mas_* tool status, so those counts were unchanged; it added the autonomousExecution block and recorded R1/R2/R3 as UNKNOWN/BLOCKED instead of measured. Phase 5.3 added the four matlab-signal-vision-ai measurement tools verified by test_signal_contract.m 42/42, the seven matlab-data-analysis verification tools verified by test_data_contract.m 118/118, and the four robotics contract tools verified by test_robotics_contract.m 162/162 alongside test_robotics.m 31/31. The Phase 5.3 full regression was 644/644 skill tests over 22 suites, 15/15 references, 15/15 cross-domain tasks and 15/15 pipeline tasks with 0 errored suites; it also ran the isolated benchmark harness 11/11 and a tool-level held-out baseline 9/9. Phase 5.4 added mas_ode_check verified by test_ode_contract.m 56/56 and mas_seg_check/mas_detect_check/mas_image_contract verified by test_vision_contract.m 103/103; the isolated benchmark gained six tool-level ODE/vision tasks (2 normal, 2 boundary, 2 fault) graded 6/6 with 0 false accepts and 0 false rejects, and a real agent episode ran 3/3 normal holdout tasks through the MATLAB MCP with grading on the evaluation side. Tool-level results are not agent-level results, and 6/6 new-domain tasks are not a full-domain success rate.
